rules: START: every engine starts in FREE TEST — calls shown as test, no press guidance.
EARN THE REAL LANE: 5 straight wins (the makes-5 gate) with zero self-borrows in the test stretch. On a roll, its calls ride the real lane.
DROP BACK TO FREE TEST: 3 straight losses in a row — it relearns on the free route until it earns its way back.
DROP BACK TO FREE TEST: a self-borrow — borrowing from its own bank is the winner's-proof tell; a true winner never has to borrow from itself in hope, so it drops to FREE TEST to relearn.
DROP BACK TO FREE TEST: a busted run (the banking FAIL -> START OVER), or the real-lane day stop (day P&L at -$2.00; armed when real fills exist — none yet).
EARN BACK: the same makes-5 gate again — 5 straight wins, clean — and the real lane reopens.
RIPTIDE has no real lane: SIM ONLY by David's standing rule. It rides FREE TEST until he gives a separate word.
FIRE = press it: the call is live, the engine is in the REAL lane, and the ask is inside the guard (PLAIN: at least 3c under the model - EARLY: at or under its 88c value line).
ICE = don't press: the ask is over the line (an ask-hole), the read is late, or the engine is in FREE TEST — watch only.
CHECK MARK: a call earns its check when it lands while the engine is on a roll (streak to 3+) AND it won at its press-card prices. Direction right but money lost at the card = no check.

PRESS CARD: every priced call carries its card — BUY at the sealed ask (what to pay to get in) · SELL at the engine's line (PLAIN: bid at 95c or hold to settlement · EARLY: the 88c TAKE VALUE line · RIPTIDE: its sealed exits) · SWITCH when the engine calls the flip, shown as the action.

SCORED AT THE CARD PRICES: each priced call is re-scored on its own card — in at the sealed ask, out at the recommended position, fees in. The card shows what the stated prices actually paid, win or lose. Calls with no sealed ask are never priced by invention.

LIVE: sealed-but-ungraded calls sit at the top as LIVE instruction cards — the same feed the watch and the cue chat carry. The cue chat is still the seconds-fast route; this page picks each call up on its sealed 10-minute refresh-and-blob loop.

STEP MIRROR: every play unfolds as a step show — STEP 1 the call seals · STEP 2 the BUY press at the card price · STEP 3 the SELL at the recommended position, or the SWITCH when the engine flips · STEP 4 the settle and the at-price score. Each step lands when its sealed record lands and carries that record's own stamp; a step with no sealed record says so. If the Shadow route is ever built and signed, its executor's steps slot into this same show, source-tagged — the show does not change.
